unanswered.text: We were looking for a dog friendly restaurant on our way home to san diego. The food was great and our dog loved what you had. The waitress was great.
unanswered.draftReply: Hi Betty, so glad you and your pup both felt at home with us on the way through. Dogs on the patio are one of our favorite things about this place, and I'm glad the food and the service lived up to the stop. Safe travels home to San Diego -- come see us next time you're headed down the coast. -- The Brewhouse

unanswered.text: Beer was not good at all. Got botulism from taco. Recovering now. Avoid this place.
unanswered.draftReply: Hi Donald, I'm sorry to hear you've been unwell -- that's not something we take lightly, and I want to look into it properly. Please contact me directly at the restaurant so I can get the date and details of your visit and review it with our kitchen. I hope you're feeling better soon. -- Joal, The Brewhouse
